title: Grateful Dead Live at Universal Amphitheatre on 1973-07-01
lineage: R1 > Technics RS-1506 > TEAC AN-300 [Dolby Decode] > Grace Design Lunatec V3 [Pre-Only] > Korg MR-1000 > DSF [1-bit 5.6448 MHz Stereo] > Korg AudioGate > WAV [24/96]
source: Sony ECM-22P > Sony TC-770 > MAR > ?? [Dolby Encode] > R1

ai_review.summary: Outstanding matrix‑type recording with crystal‑clear sound and Jerry’s liquid‑fire playing throughout a high‑energy ’73 show.
ai_review.review: The consensus is that this 1973 concert captures a superb performance—Jerry Garcia “tears it up” from start to finish and the second set delivers a memorable jam.  Technically the tape sounds almost like a matrix mix, with excellent presence, snap and sparkle; only a few reviewers note minor vocal fade‑aways or pitch/speed quirks.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers (6 of 8) award 4–5 stars praising both the musical performance and the audio quality; two low‑star comments focus on pitch issues, pulling the average down but not outweighing the strong positive consensus.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp, balanced mix with presence and sparkle; a few slurs and vocal fade‑aways noted, occasional pitch/speed concerns raised by a minority of listeners.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The show is described as consistently strong with a particularly praised second‑set jam; the flow feels tight and engaging from start to finish.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Repeatedly lauded for “liquid fire” guitar work and tearing it up throughout the concert.
